summary: The 2026-10-29 session closed at 59.22, caution, with the risk-on regime intact and model confidence at 0.9063 - 4.52 above the 2026-10-28 close of 54.70 and 3.78 below where it stood a week ago. The move is almost entirely cross-asset: 6 of 8 legs now trigger (0.75 against 0.375), lifting that dimension 37.5 points and adding 5.625 to the total while the other 5 dimensions subtract 1.11 between them. The legs that turned on are the ones the tape itself supplied - SPY closed lower, bitcoin fell 1.37936 percent, copper fell 0.6851 percent. The cash session was weak and narrow: 20 of 22 rows fell at a mean of 1.4559 percent, led down by enterprise software at 3.5207 and AI infrastructure at 3.2977, with only fintech at 1.5657 and industrial automation at 1.1815 higher. Semis lost 2.4479 and memory 1.0052 as Micron fell 4.9795 percent. China's memory chain round-tripped the prior session: all 11 names lower at a mean of 6.3053 percent, with Biwin Storage down 15.7927. Credit did not confirm the equity move - high yield tightened to 3.14 from 3.18 and the VIX print of 16.91 is Wednesday's close - which is precisely why the regime did not flip to late_cycle.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation doubles from 0.375 to 0.75 as 6 of 8 legs trigger, contributing 11.25 of the 59.22 total - 19 percent of the score from a single heuristic input. SPY closing lower, bitcoin at 79911 down 1.37936 percent and copper down 0.6851 percent supplied the 3 legs that flipped on; the dollar at 121.3202, the real rate at 2.67 and a small-cap relative weakness of 5.4583 percentage points over 63 sessions (not a one-day move) were already triggering. The dollar print is a 2026-10-23 close, 4 sessions behind the rates.

Macro at 72.80 carries a 20.0 weight and is the second-highest scoring of the 6 dimensions: the 10-year closed at 5.05 against 4.99, the 2-year slipped to 4.67 from 4.70, the 10-year minus 2-year spread widened to 0.38 from 0.29, and the real rate rose to 2.67 from 2.64. The 10-year sits at the 98.4 percentile of its own history. Every one of these is a 2026-10-28 close: the layer carries no 2026-10-29 Treasury print, so the rating of today's session is missing its rate input.

Breadth deteriorated on both of its measurable legs: the share of the 155-name universe above its 200-day average fell to 0.4581, the new-low ratio rose to 0.1154 with 18 of 156 names making new lows against 10 the day before, and the new-high ratio stalled at 0.0321. Yet the dimension added only 0.206 to the total, because its score rose just 1.03 to 60.84.

All 11 A-share names fell on 2026-10-29 at a mean of 6.3053 percent and a median of 6.3887, with Biwin Storage down 15.7927, Shannon Semiconductor down 8.0431 and Longsys down 7.3955 - an exact mirror of 2026-10-28, when all 11 rose at a mean of 6.3074. Earnings, not the AI narrative, were the mechanism: GigaDevice grew third-quarter net profit 729 percent year on year but 21 percent lower quarter on quarter, and Longsys grew 437 percent year on year against 44 percent lower quarter on quarter.

AI infrastructure fell 3.2977 and enterprise software 3.5207, the two worst of the 22 rows, while data centers held to 0.2929 and consumer electronics to 0.0803. The dispersion inside the complex is the signal: rows tied to capex financing (data centers, industrial automation) held or rose, rows tied to software multiples broke together. Note that enterprise software, cloud computing and cybersecurity are tracked through the IGV, SKYY and CIBR ETF proxies, not equal-weight baskets.

supporting_signals.claim: The dollar index at 121.3202 and the real rate at 2.67 have sat above their thresholds all week, and the small-cap leg is a 63-session measure, so 3 of the 8 legs stick to the on side by construction: the realistic floor for cross-asset is 0.375, and tape action alone cannot push it lower.

HY OAS at 3.14 contributes 4.9568, the largest single-indicator contribution after cross-asset, even though the spread narrowed from 3.18. The credit score is reading an absolute level, not a direction.
Names making new lows rose from 10 to 18 and the new-low ratio to 0.1154, moving that indicator score from 10.12 to 26.93 - deteriorating, but still far from the 50 midpoint of its own distribution.

20 of the 22 rows closed lower at a mean of 1.4559 percent and a median of 1.5555, with only fintech and industrial automation higher. The damage concentrated in long-duration software and AI infrastructure rather than in defensive cash-flow assets.

contradicting_signals.claim: VIX at 16.91 and realized volatility at 10.0854 leave the volatility dimension at 27.77, the lowest of the 6, and 3.18 points below the 2026-10-28 reading. The volatility complex does not corroborate a session in which 20 of 22 rows fell.

Credit moved the other way: high yield tightened to 3.14 from 3.18 and investment grade to 0.86 from 0.88, pulling the liquidity and credit dimension down 3.53 to 62.84. On the same day equities fell, credit priced less stress.

The regime is still risk_on: cross-asset at 0.75 clears the 0.55 gate that late_cycle requires, but VIX at 16.91 sits below the 18 threshold, so the classifier falls through to its low-volatility branch. Had Thursday's VIX printed at 18 or above, the same inputs would have produced late_cycle.

This is not a general exit: fintech rose 1.5657, industrial automation 1.1815, and consumer electronics lost only 0.0803 with gaming 0.0104. Money changed seats inside the complex rather than leaving the market.

what_changed_today: The score rose 4.52 to 59.22 from 54.70. Cross-asset added 5.625 and the remaining 5 dimensions subtracted 1.11 between them, so the increase is a single-input event, not a re-rating.
Cross-asset confirmation went from 0.375 to 0.75: 3 legs flipped on (SPY lower, bitcoin down 1.37936 percent, copper down 0.6851 percent) and none flipped off.
The 22-row tape reversed: from 6 down and 16 up at a mean gain of 0.866 on 2026-10-28 to 20 down and 2 up at a mean of 1.4559 percent lower.

China's memory chain completed a round trip: 11 names up at a mean of 6.3074 percent on 2026-10-28, 11 names down at a mean of 6.3053 percent on 2026-10-29, with Biwin Storage's 15.7927 percent the largest single-name fall in the set.

Both AI capex reads arrived after the close and outside every dataset: Amazon missed on revenue while holding capital spending high, then narrowed an after-hours fall from 12 percent to under 5 percent, and Intel guided the fourth quarter below consensus and fell more than 20 percent after hours. Neither is in the 59.22.
watch_next: Whether cross-asset holds at 0.75. The 3 legs that flipped on are daily tape signals and can flip back at the 2026-10-30 open, which would return 5.625 points.
The 2026-10-29 VIX print. At 18 or above, with cross-asset still at 0.75, the regime classifier flips from risk_on to late_cycle on unchanged inputs.

Semis into the 2026-10-30 open: Intel's guidance and Micron's 4.9795 percent fall are two ends of the same question, and the memory theme's 1.0052 percent decline understates what the after-hours tape implies.
The 2026-10-30 earnings slate: Exxon, Chevron and AbbVie before the open; Apple and Palantir on 2026-11-02; AMD on 2026-11-03.
China's memory chain after a 6.3053 percent mean decline: Sandisk guided its second quarter above consensus after the close, the one offsetting datapoint ahead of the 2026-10-30 A-share open.

bull_case.title: Bull case: this is rotation, and cross-asset is all that moved
points: Credit tightened on the day (high yield 3.14 against 3.18, investment grade 0.86 against 0.88) and VIX fell to 16.91; neither confirms stress.
Realized volatility at 10.0854 and VIX at 16.91 hold the volatility dimension at 27.77 out of 100.
Fintech at 1.5657 and industrial automation at 1.1815 rose, and data centers lost only 0.2929 - capital is rotating inside AI, not leaving it.
The score is driven by 3 of 8 daily tape readings, and 2 of them (SPY lower, copper lower) can reverse in a single session and take 3.75 points with them.

base_case.title: Base case: caution holds, range 55 to 62
points: Cross-asset stays at 0.75 because the dollar at 121.3202 and the real rate at 2.67 will not clear soon, pinning the score near 59.22.
Credit at 3.14 and VIX at 16.91 keep the model below high_risk even as breadth falls to 0.4581.
The after-hours Intel and Amazon shocks hit the 2026-10-30 semis and cloud rows without touching the macro or credit inputs, so the score moves less than the tape.

bear_case.title: Bear case: late_cycle on the next VIX print
points: A VIX print at 18 or above with cross-asset at 0.75 flips the regime to late_cycle on identical inputs.
If the 3 flipped legs hold and the dollar stays at 121.3202, cross-asset reaches 1.0 (all 8 legs) and adds 3.75 points on top of 59.22.
A memory-led China breakdown (6.3053 percent mean) plus Intel's guidance would extend the falls in semiconductor equipment at 0.6219 and semis at 2.4479 into a second session.
The 18 new lows among the 156 names keep spreading: the 0.4581 above-MA200 share has 0.1081 left before the 0.35 risk_off threshold.
